name: ab_customer_id_index
description: Does an index on orders(customer_id) help the per-customer lookup, and does it hurt the update path?

queries.name: orders_by_customer
queries.sql: SELECT id, amount, created_at FROM orders WHERE customer_id = %s

queries.name: touch_order
queries.sql: UPDATE orders SET updated_at = updated_at + interval '1 second' WHERE id = %s
